prompt: A small Roman schoolroom: a young girl student stands at a wax tablet and teaches, pointing at the letters, while her woman teacher sits on the bench as the pupil, listening and smiling.
A Roman girl studies at a table covered with wax tablets and scrolls by an oil lamp, and looks over at her friend, who has fallen asleep with her head on the table.
A Roman poet with a laurel wreath sits on a stone bench in a garden writing on a scroll, and a young woman beside him reads what he writes.
A tired, sunburnt Roman farmer in a field of wheat drinks from a clay cup while a girl pours more water from a jug; bright summer sun.
A Roman woman teacher stands with her arms folded, watching a girl student who has fallen asleep over a letter on her desk.
A young Roman woman sits by a window reading a long papyrus letter for the tenth time, smiling, with more letters beside her.
A big, strong Roman farmer sits under an olive tree with a wax tablet on his knees while a young friend teaches him to read, pointing at the letters.
A young girl student in a Roman library finds a long, beautiful scroll and reads it, amazed, while the old poet who wrote it watches from the doorway.
Four Roman friends showing off: one reads a scroll, one writes on a wax tablet, one carries a big basket of grapes, and one sleeps happily under a tree.
A Roman woman teacher leads her girl students out of the town into a big, beautiful forest, where they kneel by a stream to look at the water and the earth.
Europa, a young woman, walks arm in arm with her friend along the rocky shore of the island of Crete, the sea shining blue beside them.
A brave girl rides on the back of a big, gentle bull out of a dark forest towards a farmer, who opens his arms in joy.
Two young travellers walk with a farmer and his bull along a long, straight paved Roman road, with the city of Rome in the distance.
A Roman man teacher holds up a tunic far too long and big for him while his girl students laugh, and a huge farmer stands nearby with a jug of wine.
A Roman farmer on dry, cracked land pours wine from a jug onto a small stone altar before a statue of a god, while rain clouds gather above.
